WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT w.email_key
  FROM whatsapp_delivery_state w
  JOIN lead_processing_state l USING (email_key)
  WHERE w.email_key = $1
    AND w.status IN ('pending', 'retryable')
    AND (w.next_retry_at IS NULL OR w.next_retry_at <= now())
    AND (w.lease_until IS NULL OR w.lease_until < now())
    AND l.state IN ('pending', 'retryable')
    AND l.stage = 'whatsapp'
  FOR UPDATE OF w SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE whatsapp_delivery_state w
SET lease_until = now() + interval '5 minutes', attempt_count = w.attempt_count + 1, updated_at = now()
FROM candidate c
JOIN lead_processing_state l ON l.email_key = c.email_key
WHERE w.email_key = c.email_key
RETURNING w.email_key, w.attempt_count, l.raw_payload;

parameters.query: WITH updated_delivery AS (UPDATE whatsapp_delivery_state SET status=$2,last_http_status=NULLIF($3,'0')::integer,last_error_class=NULLIF($4,'__none__'),last_error_code=NULLIF($5,'__none__'),last_error_message=NULLIF(convert_from(decode($6,'base64'),'UTF8'),'_'),meta_message_id=NULLIF($7,'__none__'),lease_until=NULL,next_retry_at=CASE WHEN $2='retryable' THEN now()+make_interval(mins => LEAST(60,5*(2^LEAST(attempt_count-1,3))::integer)) ELSE NULL END,updated_at=now() WHERE email_key=$1 RETURNING email_key) UPDATE lead_processing_state SET state=CASE WHEN $2='accepted' THEN 'completed' WHEN $2='retryable' THEN 'retryable' WHEN $2='permanent_failure' THEN 'permanent_failure' ELSE 'manual_review' END,stage=CASE WHEN $2='accepted' THEN 'completed' ELSE 'whatsapp' END,failure_class=NULLIF($4,'__none__'),failure_code=NULLIF($5,'__none__'),failure_message=NULLIF(convert_from(decode($6,'base64'),'UTF8'),'_'),next_retry_at=CASE WHEN $2='retryable' THEN now()+interval '5 minutes' ELSE NULL END,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE email_key=$1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated_delivery) RETURNING email_key,state,stage;
